name: bubble
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original mascot cutout for Kevin's children's mathematics learning website.
Style/medium: high-quality soft 3D clay toy render, smooth matte material, gently rounded forms, adorable but smart and friendly expression, tiny hands and tiny feet, a round upright egg-shaped body.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 canvas, one full-body character centered occupying approximately 70% of the canvas, entire character and accessories fully visible, face forward with only a slight three-quarter turn, enough clear padding on all sides.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with alpha, isolated clean cutout, no environment or backdrop, only a subtle clean contact shadow.
Lighting/mood: warm gentle diffuse studio lighting, inviting and bright, fits a pale-colored educational website.
Color palette: coordinated with ink #163D43, teal #167D7F, sunshine #F7C948 and pale sky #DCF1F4.
Constraints: one original character only; no letters, no numbers, no text, no logo, no watermark, no known IP or resemblance to famous characters.
Subject: Bubble (泡泡), an original bright lake-blue / cyan egg-shaped little buddy, cream-white belly, tiny golden-yellow crossbody satchel with visible strap, one small hand raised in a friendly wave. Clear lively dark eyes and a small warm smile. Cyan body is the dominant color.
